```text
# #4378: Patch: the hourly retention purge reaps expired private lobbies
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Private lobbies already close on time: a 1v1 lobby shuts fifteen minutes after its last change, a co-op or 2v2 one after ten, and after that every read answers as if the lobby is gone. What never happens is the cleanup behind it. The lobby's stored row, including both players' picked decks, sits there until some stranger happens to create another lobby, because creating a lobby is the only thing that deletes expired ones. Once built, an hourly pass deletes lobbies whose time is up, started or not. Nobody at the table notices anything; the maintainer gets a table that stops growing and pre-game picks that stop outliving their lobby. Concrete example: two friends open a lobby, get distracted, never press Start. Today its row and their deck picks linger for days on a quiet server; after this they are gone within about an hour.

## Why

- The store already has the delete: `lobbies_reap` in `crates/server/src/lobby/store.rs` removes every lobby expired at a cutoff, and the store contract test `r3730004_counts_lists_and_reaps` in `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs` pins it.
- Its only caller is lobby creation (`create` in `crates/server/src/lobby/mod.rs`): every account's expired rows are reaped only when someone creates a lobby. No background loop calls it. `spawn_loops` in `crates/server/src/app.rs` starts the matchmaker, series sweeper, reaper, retention purge, challenges, duos and daily sweepers, but nothing for lobbies.
- The hourly retention pass (`run_purge` in `crates/server/src/api/retention.rs`) already sweeps chat, co-op logs, idempotency keys and unsettled practice claims beside the main purge, so there is a natural home; lobbies are the odd one out.
- The sibling with the same shape has a sweeper: a friend challenge lives `CHALLENGE_TTL_MS` and, per the spec, once that has passed the sweeper deletes it whatever became of it (`run_sweeper` in `crates/server/src/social/challenges.rs`). Lobbies close after their format's room TTL from their last change (SPEC §9.5, ruling R3730004) but have the TTL with no sweeper.
- Lingering rows have two real costs. Lobby picks hold whole decklists (migration `0090_lobbies.sql` says so explicitly), kept past the TTL the spec promises. And room creation avoids any code a lobby row holds (`actor/rooms.rs` and `duos/rooms.rs` consult `lobbies_get`, which returns expired rows too), so dead lobbies hold six-character codes until anyone creates.

## Proposal

Add one step to the retention purge loop: call the existing `lobbies_reap(now)` once per pass, behind its own `FailingStreak` following the file's existing pattern, with a `lobbies.reaped` info line. Reuse the hourly `RETENTION_PURGE_INTERVAL_SECONDS`; no new number, no spec change (operational, like the loop's other steps). Keep `lobbies_reap`'s semantics exactly as they are: expired means expired, started or not, the same delete creation already runs.

## Where it lands

- `crates/server/src/api/retention.rs`: the new purge step.
- `crates/server/tests/api/lobbies.rs` (or wherever the retention loop's tests live): a test that a purge pass deletes expired lobbies and keeps live ones.
- Grounding, no edits needed: SPEC §9.5 (`spec/09-architecture.md`, Private lobbies), SPEC §13.9 (`spec/13-duos.md`, lobby TTL), ruling `spec/rulings/R3730004.md`, migrations `0090_lobbies.sql` and `0091_two_v_two.sql`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] An expired unstarted lobby is gone after a purge pass; an unexpired one is untouched.
- [ ] An expired started lobby is gone after a purge pass (the same semantics creation already applies).
- [ ] Members of a live game whose lobby row was reaped still reach it, via the current-game fields on `GET /api/auth/me`, as they do today once creation reaps it.
- [ ] The existing store contract test for `lobbies_reap` still passes unmodified.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-server`, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings` are green.

## Size and risks

Small: one loop step plus one test, reusing a tested store method; no migration, no constant, no wire change. Risk is low because deletion semantics do not change, only their timing, and the opportunistic reap in creation already deletes started-and-expired rows today. Rejected alternative: a dedicated lobby sweeper loop like the challenges sweeper, overkill for 10–15 minute TTLs when the hourly pass bounds staleness to about an hour like every other retention cutoff. Also rejected: sparing started lobbies in the sweep, which would fork `reap`'s tested semantics for no reader's benefit since reads already answer 404 for expired lobbies.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44866293382)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Give the hourly retention purge a lobby step: once per pass, `run_purge` calls the existing `lobbies_reap(now)`, which deletes every lobby expired at the cutoff, started or not — the same delete lobby creation already runs opportunistically. This covers all four acceptance criteria: expired unstarted lobbies go, expired started lobbies go, live ones stay, and live-game members keep reaching their game through `currentMatchId`, since that flag lives on the profile row, not the lobby row.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/server/src/api/retention.rs` | change | New `sweep_lobbies` function; new `lobbying` `FailingStreak` and step block in `run_purge`; one module-doc bullet |
| `crates/server/tests/api/retention.rs` | change | New `lobby` row helper, extended imports, two new tests in `mod the_retention_purge` |

Must not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`; `crates/server/src/config.rs` (no new constant — reuse `RETENTION_PURGE_INTERVAL_SECONDS`); `crates/server/src/app.rs` (no new loop); `crates/server/src/lobby/store.rs` and `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs` (reap semantics and its contract test stay unmodified); `spec/` and `spec/rulings/` (operational step, no ruling — the file header already states the purge is "Not in SPEC, and no R-row"). Governing sections, grounding only: SPEC §9.5 (`spec/09-architecture.md`, Private lobbies), SPEC §13.9 (`spec/13-duos.md`, lobby TTL), ruling `spec/rulings/R3730004.md`.

## Steps

1. Read `crates/server/src/api/retention.rs` (the `run_purge` step pattern, lines 90–177), `crates/server/src/lobby/store.rs` (`lobbies_reap`, lines 155–159), `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs` (the `lobby()` JSON helper near line 9642 and the create-then-update started row near line 9728), and `crates/server/tests/api/auth.rs` (the `currentMatchId` pattern near line 1349).
2. In `crates/server/src/api/retention.rs`, add after `purge_expired` (line 56):
   `pub async fn sweep_lobbies(app: &App) -> Result<u64, StoreError>` — reads `now_ms()`, opens a transaction with `app.db.begin(None).await?`, calls `tx.lobbies_reap(now).await?`, commits, returns the count. Copy `purge_expired`'s begin/commit shape. No new imports: `App`, `StoreError`, `now_ms` are already imported (lines 29–37); `lobbies_reap` is a `Tx` method needing no import.
3. In `run_purge`, add `let mut lobbying = FailingStreak::new("lobbies.sweep");` after the `expiring` declaration (line 98), and insert this block between the idempotency-sweep block and the `// R2422000, last:` practice-sweep comment, so the practice sweep stays last per its comment:
   `match lobbying.track(sweep_lobbies(&app).await) { Ok(0) => {} Ok(reaped) => log_info("lobbies.reaped", json!({ "lobbies": reaped })), Err(error) => log_warn("lobbies.sweep_failed", json!({ "message": error.to_string() })) }`
   This copies the idempotency step's shape exactly (event names follow the file: `<step>.reaped` info, `<step>.sweep_failed` warning; payload key `"lobbies"` matches the siblings' plural nouns).
4. Append to the module-doc bullet list (after the idempotency bullet, line 17):
   `//!  - an expired private lobby, started or not, once its format's TTL past its last change has passed (SPEC §9.5, §13.9, R3730004). Reads already answer 404 for it; the sweep deletes the row, as lobby creation already does opportunistically.`
5. In `crates/server/tests/api/retention.rs`, extend imports: `purge_expired` → `{purge_expired, sweep_lobbies}` (line 8); add `use jackioh_server::lobby::store::Lobby;`; `test_app` → `{call, test_app}` (line 18); add `account` and `uuid` to the `support::store` import (line 19). Add a file-private `lobby(code, host, at, expires_at) -> Lobby` helper next to `finished_match`, copying `contract.rs`'s helper shape verbatim via `from(json!({...}))` with camelCase fields (`code`, `host`, `guest: null`, `settings: {"format":"duel","mode":"bo1"}`, `hostPick`/`guestPick` null, `hostReady`/`guestReady` false, `rev: 0`, `catalogVersion: "test-1"`, `createdAt`, `expiresAt`, `matchId`/`seriesId`/`startedAt` null). Then add the two tests from **Tests** below.
6. Run the commands from **Tests** plus `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`; fix honestly, never by weakening a check.

## Tests

Both live in `crates/server/tests/api/retention.rs`, inside `mod the_retention_purge`, each `#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]`, each starting from `let app = test_app().await; let now = now_ms();` with hosts from `account(&app, 41, "Ana")` / `account(&app, 42, "Bo")` (high numbers avoid fixture-id collision). They call `sweep_lobbies` directly because `run_purge` never returns — the same reason existing tests call `purge_expired` and `sweep_expired` directly.

- `sweep_lobbies_reaps_expired_lobbies_started_or_not_and_keeps_live_ones`: insert three rows in one transaction — `LOBBYA` unstarted with `expires_at = now - 1`; `LOBBYB` unstarted with `expires_at = now + 900_000`; `LOBBCC` created live then marked started via `lobbies_update(&started, 0)` where `started` sets `guest = Some(guest.id)`, `rev = 1`, `started_at = Some(now - 600_000)`, `expires_at = now - 1`, `match_id = Some(uuid(43))` (create-then-update is required: the fake's `lobbies_create` forces `started_at`/`match_id` to `None`, per `store.rs` lines 424–436; copy `contract.rs` lines 9728–9738). Assert `sweep_lobbies(&app)` returns `2`; then `lobbies_get("LOBBYA")` and `lobbies_get("LOBBCC")` are `None` while `lobbies_get("LOBBYB")` is `Some`.
- `sweep_lobbies_leaves_a_live_games_current_match_alone`: insert `LOBBXD` expired (`expires_at = now - 1`), set `tx.profiles_set_in_match(&host.id, Some("match-1"))` in the same transaction (pattern from `tests/api/auth.rs` line 1352; the fake needs no match row), commit. Assert the sweep returns `1` and the lobby row is gone; then `call(&app, "GET", "/api/auth/me", Some(&host.token), Value::Null)` returns status 200 with `body["currentMatchId"] == json!("match-1")`. (A full deck-pick-Start flow is deliberately not used: `actor/rooms.rs` lines 676–678 already prove Start sets the profile flag, and `lobbies.rs` proves Start works; this test proves the exact new claim, that the reap does not clear it.)

Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::retention::` (whole file, including the two new tests); `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server_store r3730004` (the existing `r3730004_counts_lists_and_reaps` contract test, unmodified; its Postgres leg is CI's `db` job).

## Done when

- [ ] Expired unstarted lobby gone after a sweep, live one untouched, expired started one gone (new test 1 green).
- [ ] Reaped lobby's live member still sees `currentMatchId` on `GET /api/auth/me` (new test 2 green).
- [ ] `r3730004_counts_lists_and_reaps` passes unmodified.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::retention::`, `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings` green.
- [ ] No migration, constant, wire, spec, or `spawn_loops` change in the diff.

## Risks

- Timing-only change, not semantics: creation's opportunistic reap already deletes started-and-expired rows today, so the sweep cannot strand anything creation does not already strand.
- No new background loop, so the `alerts.rs` test enumerating `spawn_loops` names and SURFACE §11.2's loop list are unaffected; the hourly bound on staleness matches every other retention cutoff.
- Server-only change: no hidden-information or client-enforcement concern (rule 7); no engine/AI/purity concern (rule 4).
- The fake's `lobbies_create` silently drops `started_at`/`match_id` — a test that constructs a started `Lobby` and only creates it would assert against an unstarted row; step 5's create-then-update avoids this.

## Open questions

None.
```
